gap_details.2011-2012: SIGNIFICANT. UB Neurosurgery's web presence was the ubns.com/ubneurosurgery.com ColdFusion practice site: all 73 archived cpid pages 2009-2013 fetched (titles checked), the nav JS (ubns_mainBannerNav.js) and the 'Residency Program' page (ubns.com/residency; Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2012 copy 2012-02-05: text only, 'accepts two residents per year', no names); 2010 Education Prospectus and 2010 Annual Report PDFs have no resident list. medicine.buffalo.edu had no neurosurgery pages before 2019; smbs.buffalo.edu/nsur only 1997. Reconstructed 12 people from alumni graduation years (2012-2018 grads) + 2013-14 roster PGYs (6-year numbering). Anyone who left before 2013-14 is invisible.
gap_details.2012-2013: SIGNIFICANT. New Concrete5 ubns.com launched 2012-12 but its current-residents page is first archived 2014-03-28 (Wayback exact+prefix on ubns.com and ubneurosurgery.com; CC-MAIN-2013-20/2013-48 hold only other residency-and-fellowship pages). Reconstructed 12 from alumni + 2013-14 roster.
gap_details.2013-2014: Only capture 2014-03-28 (spring); content-dated by PGY-1 Kogan/Vakharia. 12 residents, 6-year numbering; PGY-6 has only Sorkin (2014 is a 1-graduate year; the 2008 class may have lost someone unseen before 2013).
gap_details.2014-2015: No Aug-Jan capture; 2015-03-14 and 2015-05-12 identical, content-dated (PGY-1 Thind/Agyei).
gap_details.2016-2017: 2016-09-27 (ubneurosurgery.com alias; same as ubns.com 2016-08-17). Bregy printed as PGY-1 (stale); stored as PGY-2. Morrison (PGY-6) and Sonig (PGY-3, ex-endovascular fellow) first appear.
gap_details.2017-2018: Phase 2: observed (partial 'other' captures). WordPress resident profile posts (copies in CC-MAIN-2019-13/2019-22/2019-35) carry article:published_time: 2017-07-06 for Meyers, Winograd, Kogan, Vakharia, Agyei, Bregy, Jowdy, McPheeters, Sonig, Smolar (post ids 988-1028); 2017-08-15 for O'Connor, Cappuzzo, Recker, Housley (ids 1241-1250); 2018-07-02 for the 2018 class. Former-fellows page (CC-MAIN-2018-51) still prints 'Shakir ... PGY-7 Resident' and 'Sonig ... PGY-4 Resident' (2017-18 text). Morrison kept as reconstructed. Site text 2017: 'accepts two residents per year' (2 interns in 2017 = full class). All 24 CC crawls 2017-18 listed for the whole ubns.com host: no roster page, no other profile or news post. Wayback holds only 161 ubns.com URLs 2017-18, none roster-like.
